title: 2-Step Chicken
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: 2-Step Chicken.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet at a medium-high setting.
Add chicken and cook for ten minutes.
Remove chicken from pan and set aside.
Stir the soup and water together in the skillet and heat it to a boil.
Return the chicken to the skillet. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.

title: 20-Minute Chicken Creole
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: 20-Minute Chicken Creole.
steps: Heat pan over medium-high heat (350 degrees in an electric skillet). Add vegetable oil and chicken and cook until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (3-5 minutes).
Reduce heat to medium (300 degrees in electric skillet).
Add tomatoes with juice, chili sauce, green pepper, celery, onion, garlic, basil, parsley, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and simmer, covered for 10-15 minutes.
Serve over hot, cooked rice or whole wheat pasta.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

matches: beans, low-sodium undrained (pinto, kidney, red, or black 15.5 ounces)
corn, drained (15 ounces, or 10-ounce package of frozen corn)
main: beans, low-sodium undrained (pinto, kidney, red, or black 15.5 ounces)
title: 3-Can Chili
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: 3-Can Chili.

ingredients.name: beans, low-sodium undrained (pinto, kidney, red, or black 15.5 ounces)
corn, drained (15 ounces, or 10-ounce package of frozen corn)

steps: 1. Place the contents of all 3 cans into a pan.
2. Add chili powder to taste.
3. Stir to mix.
4. Continue to stir over medium heat until heated thoroughly.
5. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: 5 A Day Bulgur Wheat
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: 5 A Day Bulgur Wheat.

ingredients.name: green pepper (small, chopped, - may use red or yellow pepper)

steps: Wash and chop fresh onion, broccoli, carrots, pepper and parsley (if using fresh parsley).
Heat canola oil in a large skillet. Add onions and cook until soft.
Add bulgur and stir to coat. Add 2 cups chicken broth to the skillet, bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, add remaining vegetables and chickpeas. Cook for 10 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Add parsley and stir. Serve warm or cold.

title: A Simple Mexican Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: A Simple Mexican Salad.
steps: 1. Wash the cucumbers, oranges and lemon or lime under cold running water.
2. Slice the cucumbers. Peel and cut the oranges into small pieces.
3. Place cucumber slices and orange pieces in a medium size bowl. Add chili powder, lemon or lime juice and salt.

title: Ambrosia
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Ambrosia.
steps: Drain pineapple and oranges. Use juice as beverage.
Combine fruit with marshmallows and coconut.
Fold in yogurt.

title: Angel Food Cake
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Angel Food Cake.
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 325°F. In a large mixing bowl, beat the egg whites until they are foamy.
2. Add the cream of tartar and beat until stiff, but not dry. Gradually beat in the sugar
3. Add the vanilla and salt and then gently fold in the flour.
4. Pour the mix into an angel food tubular pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until the top is nicely browned.

title: Angel Food Pastry with Fresh Berries and Whipped Cream
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Angel Food Pastry with Fresh Berries and Whipped Cream.
steps: Scoop 3 Tablespoons of angel food cake mix into a microwave-safe cup or mug.
Add 2 Tablespoons of vanilla yogurt and stir.
Place in the center of the microwave oven and microwave for 1 minute.
Take out of microwave and let cool for 1 minute.
Using a knife, cut around the sides of the cup to loosen the cake and "dump" it on a plate.
Dole 1 Tablespoon of whipped topping on top of the cake.
Sprinkle raspberries around the angel cake and add sliced strawberries to top.

title: Any Days a Picnic Chicken Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Any Days a Picnic Chicken Salad.
steps: .1. Wash hands with soap and water.
2. Combine all ingredients.
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
4. Use within 1-2 days. Chicken salad does not freeze well.
How to use
- Make chicken salad sandwiches.
- Make a pasta salad by mixing with 2 cups cooked pasta.
- Kids will love this salad served in a tomato or a cucumber boat.

matches: mini baguette or Italian bread (split lengthwise, or 2 split English muffins)
main: mini baguette or Italian bread (split lengthwise, or 2 split English muffins)
title: Anytime Pizza
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Anytime Pizza.

ingredients.name: mini baguette or Italian bread (split lengthwise, or 2 split English muffins)

steps: 1. Toast the bread or English muffin until slightly brown.
2. Top bread or muffin with pizza sauce, vegetables and low-fat cheese.
3. Sprinkle with Italian seasonings as desired.
4. Return bread to toaster oven (or regular oven preheated to 350 degrees).
5. Heat until cheese melts.

matches: chicken breasts (skinless, cooked, diced, about 2 cups)
title: Apple & Chicken Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple & Chicken Salad.

ingredients.name: chicken breasts (skinless, cooked, diced, about 2 cups)
lettuce leaves (Bibb, Romaine, green or red leaf)

steps: Cut apples in quarters; remove core and chop.
In a medium size bowl, mix all ingredients, except lettuce.
To serve, arrange lettuce on serving plates top with apple and chicken salad.

matches: 1/2 medium apples, sliced (14 oz. of sliced apples)
title: Apple Banana Salad with Peanuts
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Banana Salad with Peanuts.

ingredients.name: 1/2 medium apples, sliced (14 oz. of sliced apples)

steps: Whisk together dressing ingredients.
Slice bananas.
In a large salad bowl, toss mixed greens, banana and apple slices, peanuts, and dressing.

title: Apple Cake
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Cake.
steps: 1. Beat butter with sugar until creamy.
2. Add eggs one at a time, beating until well blended.
3. Add flour, baking powder, and lemon rind, beat 4 minutes.
4. Pour into greased 9-inch spring-form pan.
5. Arrange the apples on the batter, sprinkle with 2 teaspoons sugar.
6. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.
7. Remove from pan, brush apples with jam, cool.

matches: carrots (large, peeled and cut into chunks)
title: Apple Carrot Soup
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Carrot Soup.

ingredients.name: carrots (large, peeled and cut into chunks)

steps: 1. In a large pot over high heat, combine all ingredients, bring to a boil.
2. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until soup reduces to about 8 cups of liquid, about 3 to 4 hours.
3. Skim fat from surface and serve.
4. Store leftover soup covered in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Apple Chunk Cake
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Chunk Cake.
steps: Preheat oven to 350° F.
Wash hands with soap and water.
In a large bowl, mix sugar, oil and eggs together. Beat well.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, salt, cinnamon, and baking soda. Add to egg batter and mix well.
Add apple chunks and applesauce to the batter. Stir to combine.
Coat an 8x8 inch baking pan with vegetable oil spray, and pour in batter.
Bake until done, about 1 hour.
Place apple slices on top of apple cake and serve.

title: Apple Cinnamon Bars
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Cinnamon Bars.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Put the flour, salt, baking soda, cinnamon, brown sugar, and oats in the mixing bowl. Stir together.
Add the shortening to the bowl. Use the 2 table knives to mix the ingredients and cut them into crumbs.
Lightly grease the bottom and sides of the baking dish with a little bit of shortening.
Spread half of the crumb mixture in the greased baking dish.
Remove the core from the apples and slice them. Put the apple slices into the baking dish.
Top the apples with the rest of the crumb mixture.
Bake in the oven for 40 – 45 minutes.
Cut into squares. It will fall apart easily.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Coffee Cake.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Lightly oil a 13x9x2 inch pan.
In a large mixing bowl, combine apples with sugar, raisins, and pecans; mix well. Let stand 30 minutes.
Stir in oil, vanilla, and egg. Sift together flour, soda, and cinnamon; stir into apple mixture about 1/3 at a time, just enough to moisten dry ingredients.
Turn batter into pan. Bake 35-40 minutes. Cool cake slightly before serving.

title: Apple Coleslaw
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Coleslaw.
steps: 1. Wash your hands with soap and water.
2. Wash the cabbage. Cut it into fine shreds, until you have 2 cups of cabbage.
3. Peel the carrot. Grate it with a grater.
4. Chop half a green pepper into small pieces.
5. Remove the core, and chop the apple.
6. Put the cabbage, carrot, green pepper, and apple in a large mixing bowl. Stir together.
7. Put the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and dill weed in a small bowl. Stir together to make a dressing.
8. Pour the dressing over the salad. Toss to mix.

matches: boneless, skinless chicken breast (cut to 1/2" cubes)
main: boneless, skinless chicken breast (cut to 1/2" cubes)
title: Apple Corn Chili
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apple Corn Chili.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast (cut to 1/2" cubes)
red apples, such as Braeburn, Empire, or Fuji (chopped, skin on)
15 oz. can black beans (no-salt-added, drained and rinsed)

steps: In a stockpot, heat 1 tbsp. olive oil; add chicken and brown (about 5 minutes). Remove chicken from pan.
Heat remaining olive oil in same pot; add onions and garlic and sauté until soft.
Add corn and sauté until golden brown. Add apple, cumin, and cayenne pepper (if desired); cook about 3-4 minutes. Let cool about 5 minutes.
Set aside about 1 cup of mixture. Purée remainder in food processor or blender, adding a portion of water, if needed, and return to pot.
Add browned chicken, black beans, chiles, bouillon, and water. Bring to boil and simmer about 15 minutes. Chicken should be cooked to 165 ºF.
To serve, ladle soup in bowls and top with non-puréed portion of apple corn mixture.

title: Pan Roasted Tilapia with Tomatillo Salsa
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Pan Roasted Tilapia with Tomatillo Salsa.

ingredients.name: tilapia fillets (patted dry with a paper towel, any inexpensive white fish can be used)

steps: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
To make the tomatillo salsa: (Canned tomatillo salsa can be used instead of fresh)
To prepare the tomatillos, peel back the husk from the smooth green tomatillo skin. Rinse the tomatillos with warm water and cut into quarters.

Place the husked tomatillos, onion, chilies, garlic, and 1 teaspoon oil in the baking pan, stir well and transfer to the oven. Roast about 20 minutes until the tomatillos are soft and dark green. Set aside to cool.
Transfer the mixture to the blender; add the salt, lime juice, and cilantro and puree.
To cook the tilapia:
Place the skillet on the stove over high heat and when it is hot, carefully add 2 teaspoons oil.
Put the tilapia fillets in the pan, waiting about 30 seconds between additions. Cook about 5–6 minutes, until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer the tilapia to the serving plate and top with generous amounts of salsa. Serve right away.

matches: chicken or turkey (cooked, diced and boned)
title: Brunswick Stew
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Brunswick Stew.

ingredients.name: chicken or turkey (cooked, diced and boned)
whole kernel corn, canned or cooked

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large pan. Add onion and cook in oil until tender.
2. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a simmer for 30 minutes at medium-low.
3. Makes 8 servings of about 1 cup each.

title: Peachy Peanut Butter Pita Pockets
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Peachy Peanut Butter Pita Pockets.
steps: 1. Cut pitas in half to make 4 pockets and warm in the microwave for about 10 seconds to make them more flexible.
2. Carefully open each pocket and spread a thin layer of peanut butter on the inside walls.
3. Fill with a combination of apple, banana, and peach slices. Serve at room temperature.

title: Braised Chicken Thighs with Spinach
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Braised Chicken Thighs with Spinach.

ingredients.name: package 10-ounce frozen spinach (or 1 bunch fresh spinach)

steps: Heat skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 teaspoon oil. Add chicken, top side down. Cook about 8 minutes on each side, or until deeply browned. Remove the chicken to a dinner plate and set aside.
Reheat skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, thyme, and rosemary. Cook about 5 minutes, until the onion is soft and golden. Return the chicken to the pan.
Add the water, and cover. Continue cooking for about 30 minutes.
Add frozen spinach and cook for about 10 minutes. Or, add the fresh spinach and cook about 2 minutes, until it wilts. Serve right away.

matches: fresh parsley, chopped (optional, or 2 Tablespoons dried parsley)
main: fresh parsley, chopped (optional, or 2 Tablespoons dried parsley)
title: Slow Cooker Lentil Soup
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Slow Cooker Lentil Soup.

ingredients.name: fresh parsley, chopped (optional, or 2 Tablespoons dried parsley)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in slow cooker.
2. Cook on LOW for 8 to 10 hours or HIGH for 4 to 5 hours.
3. Serve hot with crackers or bread.

matches: berries, fresh or frozen (blackberries, raspberries, blueberries, sliced strawberries, or a mixture)
title: Any Berry Sauce
description: Use blackberries, raspberries, blueberries, strawberries, or a mixture to make this Any Berry Sauce. It's low fat, low sodium, vegeterian, and is great with pancakes or oatmeal.

ingredients.name: berries, fresh or frozen (blackberries, raspberries, blueberries, sliced strawberries, or a mixture)

steps: In a medium saucepan, mix together sugar, cornstarch, water, and 2 cups of berries. Mash berries if desired.
Heat over medium heat, stirring frequently, until sauce starts to thicken.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining berries. Mash if desired.
Serve over pancakes, waffles, oatmeal, or yogurt.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Applesauce French Toast
description: This applesauce French toast recipe is a healthy twist on a breakfast classic. Unsweetened applesauce gives it a moist, chewy texture that kids will love.
steps: Wash hands with soap and water.
In a large mixing bowl, combine eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar, vanilla and applesauce. Mix well.
Soak bread one slice at a time until mixture is slightly absorbed.
Lightly grease a skillet or griddle. Cook over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.
Serve hot.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

matches: baking apple (try Golden Delicious, Granny Smith, Jonathan, or Braeburn)
main: baking apple (try Golden Delicious, Granny Smith, Jonathan, or Braeburn)
title: Baked Apple and Cranberries
description: Baked Apple and Cranberries is the perfect warm winter dish for breakfast or dessert. Try it with Golden Delicious, Granny Smith, Jonathan, or Braeburn apples.

ingredients.name: baking apple (try Golden Delicious, Granny Smith, Jonathan, or Braeburn)

steps: Wash apple and remove core (seed area), leaving the bottom to hold in the filling.
Peel a small band of skin from around the top of the apple.
Place the apple in a microwave safe container.
Sprinkle cinnamon around the top of the apple and into the hole.
Fill the center of the apple with cranberries, pressing down if needed.
Top the cranberries with the brown sugar and margarine or butter.
Cover loosely with wax paper.
Microwave on high for about 2 1/2 minutes or until apple is soft when poked through the center hole with a fork. Cool slightly.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Breakfast Banana Split
description: Bananas, pineapple, yogurt, and granola, what a healthy way to start your day! Treat yourself and your kids with this healthy breakfast treat.

ingredients.name: honey, optional (skip for children under the age of one)

steps: Peel and split banana lengthwise. Place half in two separate cereal bowls.
Sprinkle granola over banana, reserving some for topping.
Spoon yogurt on top and drizzle with honey.
Decorate with reserved granola and pineapple.
Serve immediately.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Cherry Puff Pancake
description: This cherry puff pancake is a simple take on European strudel. Cherries bring tart, sweet flavor and almonds add crunchy texture to this breakfast treat.

ingredients.name: halved, pitted sweet cherries, fresh or frozen, thawed and drained

steps: Wash hands with soap and water.
Preheat oven to 450 Â°F.
In a medium bowl or blender, beat the eggs, milk and vanilla together until well blended.
Mix the flour, sugar and cinnamon together. Add to the liquid ingredients and mix until there are no lumps.

Put margarine or butter in a 10- or 11-inch oven proof skillet or a 2 1/2- to 3-quart baking dish. Place the skillet or dish in the hot oven until the margarine or butter is melted and bubbly. Remove from the oven. Quickly spread the cherries across the bottom of the hot skillet or dish.
Pour the batter over the cherries and sprinkle with almond slices, if using.

Return to the oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until the edges are browned and the puffs in the middle are golden. Cool slightly before cutting into 4 pieces. The center puffs will flatten during cooling.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Corn Pancakes
description: These light, crispy corn pancakes are a breakfast favorite! Use canned, frozen, or fresh cooked corn.

ingredients.name: cooked corn (canned and drained, frozen, or fresh cooked)

steps: Wash hands with soap and water.
In a large bowl, mix corn meal, flour, baking powder and salt.
In another bowl, mix together the eggs and milk. Add egg and milk mixture and corn to the flour mixture and mix until combined.
Lightly grease a large skillet or griddle. Heat skillet or griddle over medium heat (300 Â°F in an electric skillet). Pour batter onto hot griddle to make individual pancakes.
Cook until golden on the bottom. Turn and cook on other side.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

matches: bread cubes; try whole grain bread
fruit, sliced or chopped- fresh, frozen or canned
main: bread cubes; try whole grain bread
title: Fruity French Toast Casserole
description: Need help in the kitchen? This Fruity French Toast Casserole recipe is an easy way to get kids cooking.

ingredients.name: bread cubes; try whole grain bread
fruit, sliced or chopped- fresh, frozen or canned

steps: Lightly oil or spray an 8-inches by 8-inches baking dish or 2-quart casserole. Add bread cubes and fruit.
In a medium bowl, blend eggs, milk, vanilla, and sugar. Pour over bread cubes and fruit. Stir gently to wet all bread with egg mixture.
Cover and refrigerate until all liquid is absorbed (30 mins), or overnight.
Just before baking, remove casserole from refrigerator. Preheat oven to 350 Â°F.
Make the topping: In a small bowl, combine the softened margarine, sugar, and flour with a fork until crumbly.

Uncover the casserole and sprinkle topping over fruit. Bake until completely set, and starting to brown, (160 Â°F in the center), about 35-40 minutes. A longer baking time is needed when dish is chilled overnight. Serve warm.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Green Pineapple Power Smoothie
description: This pineapple green power smoothie is a refreshing blend of pineapple, banana, spinach, and yogurt. A delicious way to add more leafy greens to your diet!
steps: Wash hands with soap and water.
Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Puree until completely smooth.
Serve immediately.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Oatmeal Pecan Waffles (or Pancakes)
description: Your children will jump right out of bed for this delicious meal.

ingredients.name: large eggs, separated (for pancakes, see note)
fresh strawberries, rinsed, stems removed, and cut in half (or substitute frozen strawberries, thawed)
fresh blackberries, rinsed (or substitute frozen blackberries, thawed)
fresh blueberries, rinsed (or substitute frozen blueberries, thawed)

steps: Preheat waffle iron.
Combine flour, oats, baking powder, sugar, and pecans in a large bowl.
Combine egg yolks, milk, and vegetable oil in a separate bowl, and mix well.
Add liquid mixture to the dry ingredients, and stir together. Do not overmix; mixture should be a bit lumpy.
Whip egg whites to medium peaks. Gently fold egg whites into batter (for pancakes, see note below).

Pour batter into preheated waffle iron, and cook until the waffle iron light signals it's done or steam stops coming out of the iron. (A waffle is perfect when it is crisp and well-browned on the outside with a moist, light, airy and fluffy inside.) (Or make pancakes.)
Add fresh fruit and a light dusting of powdered sugar to each waffle, and serve.

title: Overnight Oatmeal
description: Overnight oatmeal is a healthy simple breakfast that you can make ahead for busy mornings. Just add oats, yogurt, milk, and you're favorite fruit and refrigerate overnight.

ingredients.name: chopped apple (about 1/3 of a medium apple [3 inches in diameter])

steps: In a medium bowl, mix oats, yogurt and milk.
Add the fruit now or add just before eating.
Cover and refrigerate oatmeal mixture for 6-12 hours.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

matches: medium green bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped
medium red bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped
title: Chicken Picadillo
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Chicken Picadillo.

ingredients.name: medium green bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped
medium red bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped
boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
fresh cilantro, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or substitute 1 tsp dried coriander) 1 Tbsp capers, drained 2 Tbsp green olives, chopped

steps: Heat olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add the onion, bell peppers, and garlic, and sauté until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken, and stir fry for another 5–10 minutes until chicken is no longer pink inside.
Add the tomato sauce, chicken broth, lemon juice, cumin, bay leaves, water, and raisins to the vegetables and chicken.
Cover the pan, and reduce the heat. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves, and garnish with fresh cilantro, capers, and green olives, and serve.

matches: fresh garlic, minced (about 3 cloves) (or 1 tsp dried)
fresh ginger, minced (or ¼ tsp dried)
main: fresh garlic, minced (about 3 cloves) (or 1 tsp dried)
title: Wiki (Fast) Rice
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Wiki (Fast) Rice.

ingredients.name: fresh garlic, minced (about 3 cloves) (or 1 tsp dried)
fresh ginger, minced (or ¼ tsp dried)
½ C canned sliced water chestnuts, drained
C cooked mixed vegetables (or ½ bag frozen stir-fry vegetable mix) (Leftover Friendly)

steps: Heat canola oil in a large wok or sauté pan over medium heat. Add garlic, ginger, and scallions, and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add water chestnuts, and continue to cook until they begin to soften, another 1–2 minutes.
Add vegetables, and toss until heated through, about 2–3 minutes (or up to 5 minutes for frozen vegetables).
Add rice, and continue to cook until hot, about 3–5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss well, and serve.

title: Ampalaya (Bitter Melon) With Pork
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Ampalaya (Bitter Melon) With Pork.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Lightly sauté onion and garlic.
Add the ground pork, and cook until almost done.
Add the sliced ampalaya (bitter melon). Cover and simmer until the bitter melon turns green. Do not overcook.
Season with lite soy sauce and black pepper, and serve.

title: Sautéed Mung Beans (Munggo Guisado)
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Sautéed Mung Beans (Munggo Guisado).

ingredients.name: C (4 oz) lean pork, thinly sliced
3½ C precooked mung beans (from 1¾ C dried beans)
C frozen leaf spinach (about ⅔ of a 10-oz package)

steps: In a large skillet, heat the oil, and sauté the garlic until lightly browned.
Add onions and tomatoes. Sautée until skin begins to curl.
Add pork, and sauté until lightly browned.
Add 4 cups water, and simmer pork for about 15 minutes.
Add the mung beans, and continue to simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Add the shrimp and frozen leaf spinach, and cook for 4 minutes or until done.

title: Cantaloupe Crush
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Cantaloupe Crush.

ingredients.name: Sweetener as needed (about 1 to 2 tsp sugar or equivalent of other sweetener)

steps: Cut cantaloupe into small cubes or thin strips.
Mix cantaloupe, milk, and ice in a blender until smooth.
Sweeten to taste. Serve.

matches: package (6 oz) dried apricots, cut into small pieces
main: package (6 oz) dried apricots, cut into small pieces
title: Apricot-Orange Bread
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Apricot-Orange Bread.

ingredients.name: package (6 oz) dried apricots, cut into small pieces
½ C nonfat dry milk powder

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly oil two 9×5-inch loaf pans.
Cook apricots in water in a covered medium-sized saucepan for 10 to 15 minutes, or until tender but not mushy. Drain; reserve ¾ cup of the liquid. Set apricots aside to cool.
Cream together the margarine and sugar. By hand, beat in the egg and orange peel.
In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, dry milk powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with reserved apricot liquid and orange juice.
Stir apricot pieces and pecans into batter.
Turn batter into prepared pans.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, or until bread springs back when lightly touched in center.
Cool each loaf for 5 minutes in the pan. Remove from pan and completely cool on wire rack before slicing.

title: Banana-Nut Bread
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Banana-Nut Bread.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly oil a 9×5-inch loaf pan.
Stir together mashed bananas and buttermilk; set aside.
Cream brown sugar and margarine together until fluffy. Beat in egg. Add banana mixture; beat well.
Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; add all at once to liquid ingredients. Stir until well blended.
Stir in nuts, and turn into the prepared pan.
Bake for 50 to 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes in the pan.
Remove from pan and complete cooling on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Carrot-Raisin Bread
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Carrot-Raisin Bread.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly oil a 9×5-inch loaf pan.
Stir together the dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of the dry mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together remaining ingredients; add this mixture all at once to dry ingredients. Stir just enough to moisten and evenly distribute the carrots.
Turn into the prepared pan. Bake for 50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes in the pan. Remove from pan and complete cooling on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Chicken Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Chicken Salad.
steps: Bake chicken, cut into cubes, and refrigerate.
In a large bowl, combine the rest of the ingredients. Add chilled chicken, and mix well.

matches: potatoes (about 6 large), boiled in jackets, peeled and cut into ½-inch cubes
main: potatoes (about 6 large), boiled in jackets, peeled and cut into ½-inch cubes
title: Garden Potato Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Garden Potato Salad.

ingredients.name: potatoes (about 6 large), boiled in jackets, peeled and cut into ½-inch cubes

steps: In a large bowl, place potatoes, celery, green onion, and parsley.
Meanwhile, in a blender or food processor, blend cottage cheese, milk, lemon juice, vinegar, celery seed, dill weed, dry mustard, and white pepper until smooth. Chill for 1 hour.
Pour chilled cottage cheese mixture over vegetables; mix well.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: New Potato Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: New Potato Salad.
steps: Thoroughly clean potatoes with a vegetable brush and water.
Boil potatoes for 20 minutes or until tender.
Drain, and cool potatoes for 20 minutes.
Cut potatoes into quarters and mix with olive oil, onions, and spices.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Tuna Salad
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Tuna Salad.
steps: Rinse and drain tuna for 5 minutes. Break apart with a fork.
Add celery, onions, and mayonnaise, and mix well.

title: 1-2-3 Peach Cobbler
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: 1-2-3 Peach Cobbler.

ingredients.name: ¼ C pineapple juice or peach juice (if desired, use juice reserved from canned peaches)
(16 oz each) peaches, packed in juice, drained (or 1¾ lb fresh peaches, sliced)

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Combine cinnamon, vanilla, cornstarch, peach nectar, and juice in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles.
Add sliced peaches to mixture. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
In another saucepan, melt margarine and set aside.
Lightly spray an 8-inch-square glass dish with cooking spray. Pour hot peach mixture into dish.
In a mixing bowl, combine the pancake mix, flour, sugar, and melted margarine. Stir in evaporated milk. Quickly spoon this mixture over the peach mixture.
Combine nutmeg and brown sugar in a small bowl. Sprinkle mixture on top of batter.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool and cut into eight squares.

title: Southern Banana Pudding
description: An everyday recipe from a U.S. public-domain cookbook collection: Southern Banana Pudding.

ingredients.name: small packages (4-serving size each) fat-free, sugar-free instant vanilla pudding and pie-filling mix

steps: Mix 3½ cups of the milk with the pudding mixes. Beat the mixture with a wire whisk for 2 minutes, until it is well blended. Let stand for 5 minutes.
Fold 1 cup of the whipped topping into the pudding mixture.

Arrange a layer of wafers on the bottom and sides of a 2-quart serving bowl. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of the remaining milk over the wafers. Add a layer of banana slices, and top with one-third of the pudding.
Repeat layers, drizzling each wafer layer with remaining milk, and ending with pudding. Spread the remaining whipped topping over the pudding.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Buckwheat Ginger Banana Cake
description: A gluten-free ginger banana cake made with buckwheat flour, maple syrup, and dark chocolate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C (338°F).
Mix the buckwheat flour, baking powder, and baking soda in a bowl, and set aside.
Mix the maple syrup with the applesauce, the lemon juice, and the grated ginger. Mash the bananas with a fork and mix them with the other wet ingredients.
Combine the dry ingredients with the banana mixture. Be careful not to overmix.
Add the dark chocolate and gently mix again.
Line a 20 x 20 cm (8 x 8 inch) pan with parchment and pour in the batter.
Bake for about 45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
